PLAN 10 | SHOTS 24-25 | THE SHADOWS ARE TAKEN
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 2 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_ZAHHAK = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_STAFF = {{PROP_STAFF}}
PROP_BLADE = {{PROP_BLADE}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_POSSESSION_PEAK. Start with exactly two detached human floor silhouettes just ahead of the women, stretching toward Zahhak. Shahrnaz left, Arnavaz right; fixed feet and guard positions. Reduced light from the previous block is locked. Zahhak is staff-supported with a slight limp established; his left palm stays open.

SHOT 24 | 00:00-00:09 | TWO SHADOWS ONE DESTINATION
28mm low wide view from beside the sisters, on the established entrance side. Include both bodies, both floor silhouettes and Zahhak’s staff base. The two shadows travel across the visible floor seams toward the staff in one continuous flow. Shahrnaz’s silhouette arrives first. Arnavaz pulls her shoulders backward once; her shadow follows and is absorbed into the same dark patch. The camera advances only half a meter.
SHOT 25 | 00:09-00:15 | THE BODY AFTER
Cut to a 65mm two-shot of the sisters. Shahrnaz’s protective stroking has stopped. Arnavaz’s clenched fingers slowly open; her upright defiance collapses into a still lowered head. Both remain standing and breathing. The living cat makes one small ear turn. In soft background Zahhak lowers his left palm, right hand still on the staff. Hold the final empty posture.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
The rear-left source stays fixed, fill remains at its reduced level. The effect is entirely a change in darkness across stone: solid bodies, tangible costume and stable architecture.
SOUND
One long breath from Shahrnaz, Arnavaz’s held breath releasing later, fabric settling and distant hall air. Let the final three seconds approach silence.
END STATE AND EDIT
Both detached human silhouettes have merged into the dark patch beneath Zahhak’s staff. Only faint contact shade remains at the women’s feet. Their arms and shoulders settle into empty stillness; Shahrnaz’s arms continue supporting the cat. Zahhak lowers his left palm.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

- PLAN 10 | SHOTS 24A–24C | THE BODY BECOMES OBEDIENT

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9.
Three shots lasting six, five and four seconds.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak and his established shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
Zahhak’s chamber = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}

PROP REFERENCE:
Zahhak’s staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}

SPATIAL AND LIGHT CONTINUITY:

Shahrnaz stands on the western mark, Arnavaz on the eastern mark. Their bodies face north beneath the same hard overhead spotlight.

Shahrnaz holds the cat.
Arnavaz retains her lowered left shoulder and dusty clothing.

Zahhak starts immediately behind Shahrnaz, south of her. He carries the staff in his right hand.

The room remains dark beyond the shared pool of light. Preserve the spotlight’s position and intensity.

SHOT 24A | 00:00–00:06 | SHAHRNAZ

50mm close handheld camera WEST of Shahrnaz, looking EAST.

Shahrnaz’s profile faces screen-left.
Zahhak starts screen-right behind her.

During the first two seconds, follow Zahhak as he retraces the short route around her western side and comes to stand directly NORTH of her.

He now appears screen-left, facing screen-right toward her.
Shahrnaz remains screen-right, facing screen-left toward him.

Once his feet are planted, he lifts the staff with his right hand. The shaft angles down and away from her body.

Place the staff’s decorative head gently against the center of her mask’s forehead. Draw it down the outer surface of the mask in one slow, continuous pass, finishing at the chin.

Keep the contact and both opposing profiles readable.

Shahrnaz initially recoils a few centimeters and holds her breath. As the staff leaves her chin, she exhales slowly. Her shoulders lower; the hand stroking the cat becomes still. Both forearms continue supporting its weight.

SHOT 24B | 00:06–00:11 | ARNAVAZ

Cut to a 50mm camera EAST of Arnavaz, looking WEST.

Arnavaz appears screen-left, facing screen-right toward north.
Zahhak appears screen-right, facing screen-left toward her.

At the start, Zahhak completes one short sideways step from Shahrnaz’s position to stand directly north of Arnavaz. Shahrnaz remains farther west, softly visible beyond them.

Arnavaz turns her mask slightly away from the approaching staff, then brings it back as Zahhak follows her with a small wrist adjustment.

With his feet stationary, he makes the same single downward pass: staff head touching the mask from the central forehead to the chin.

Her right hand clenches during contact. As the staff separates from her chin, her fingers slowly uncurl and her head settles.

Keep the staff rigid and unchanged throughout the movement.

SHOT 24C | 00:11–00:15 | THE ABSENCE OF RECOIL

Cut to a 50mm two-shot from NORTH of the sisters, looking SOUTH, just beside Zahhak.

Arnavaz’s FRONT appears screen-left.
Shahrnaz’s FRONT appears screen-right.
A narrow edge of Zahhak’s BACK occupies the extreme right foreground.

Zahhak lowers the staff to the floor.

Both women remain looking toward him. Their breathing becomes slow and nearly synchronized. Neither withdraws when his shoulder moves close to their sightline.

Shahrnaz holds the cat securely but has stopped comforting it.
Arnavaz’s open hands hang beside her body.

Let the camera’s earlier tremor settle into almost complete stillness during this shot.

IMAGE AND SOUND:

The possession is visible in the transition from resisted contact to sustained bodily stillness. Preserve the same masks and physical appearance.

The overhead light remains constant throughout.

Sound: close breathing, soft staff contact against the mask material, cloth settling and the staff returning to stone. The final held moment contains sparse room tone.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
